policy: During beta and launch rehearsal, production monitoring must prove live health, public acquisition pages, public sharing, viral affordances, visual stability, launch-signoff evidence, and rollback readiness. Any P0/P1 signal failure blocks public launch until fixed or rolled back.

monitors.name: Production release gate
monitors.cadence: every 6 hours and manually after deploys

monitors.name: Production visual gate
monitors.cadence: daily and manually before public launch approval

triggers: Any 5xx on monitored pages or APIs
/api/health is not ok or reports criticalMissing above 0
public share route loses trip-specific metadata or itinerary content
public share feedback API stops returning structured JSON
visual gate reports app errors, horizontal overflow, clipped primary text, overlapping controls, or unexpected stable-route diffs
release gate fails any production smoke, auth, commercial, share, viral, visual, or prompt-suite task
launch signoff fails current-production, evidence, risk-register, beta-review, visual-review, monitoring, or rollback checks
firstResponseSteps: Confirm the exact failing URL, workflow, run id, and timestamp.
Open the production health endpoint and compare deployment metadata to the latest known good commit.
Run the matching production QA command locally from client/ with the same base URL and share slug.
Rollback immediately for confirmed P0 or launch-blocking P1 issues when a patch is not ready in the same release window.
Record the issue, command output, owner, and follow-up in RELEASE_READINESS_MEMO.md or a qa/ evidence file.
